title: Air-quality monitoring
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Identify the source of the emissions.
3. Collect real-time data from any available monitoring equipment.
4. Take ambient air quality samples.
5. Record data on weather conditions at the time of the readings.
6. Document the emissions in terms of concentration and duration.
7. List the specific pollutants detected (e.g., PM2.5, PM10, NOx, SO2, CO, VOCs).
8. Compare recorded levels against local and international air quality standards.
9. Provide photographic and/or video evidence, if possible.
10. Indicate any occurrences of visible emissions such as smoke or odors.
11. Note any measurements of elevated temperatures or other operational conditions that may indicate excessive emissions.
12. Gather feedback from nearby community members regarding any observed impacts or discomfort.
13. Record any relevant regulatory permits, and whether they are being adhered to or violated.
14. Keep a chronological log of your observations and data collection efforts.
15.
